title: Sunday School
summary: We will read and discuss Mark Chapter 3
details:
What happens when doing good gets you into trouble?

In Mark 3, Jesus heals a man—and instead of celebrating, the religious leaders begin plotting against him. His popularity is growing, his own family questions his actions, and some accuse him of being in league with the devil!

Why was Jesus such a threat? Why did even those closest to him struggle to understand him? And what did Jesus mean when he said that whoever does God's will is his family?

**Join us Wednesday, Nov. 18, 7 pm on Zoom** as we explore a chapter filled with controversy, surprising confrontations, and questions that are just as relevant today.

No homework required—just bring your curiosity and willingness to join the conversation!
